title: Descent of comparison through fraction relations
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], L an invertible O_X-module [def-sc-invertible-module], F any O_X-module, and s a global section of L. Write H^p(W,G) for open module cohomology [def-sc-open-module-cohomology], and C^p(W) for CohomologyFractionPresentation L F s p W [def-sc-cohomology-fraction-presentation], with generator [n,xi]. Let S be the nonvanishing open of s. There are additive maps c(W,p):C^p(W) -> H^p(W intersect S,F) simultaneously for all W,p such that multiplication by s^n applied to c(W,p)([n,xi]) is xi restricted to W intersect S. There is no assertion of exactness or bijectivity of c.

proof.text: Obtain the individual-twist division maps q with their transition compatibility.

Extend q to the direct sum using DirectSum.toAddMonoid. Each generating relation iota_n(xi)-iota_(n+b)(s^b xi) maps to zero by transition compatibility. AddSubgroup.closure_le puts the subgroup of relations in its kernel.
Use QuotientAddGroup.lift. Evaluate its value on the generator using lift_mk and DirectSum.toAddMonoid_of, then apply the division formula.

theorem exists_cohomologyFraction_comparison (X : Scheme.{uMV}) (L F : X.Modules) [L.IsInvertible]
    (s : Γ(L, ⊤))
    (S : X.Opens) (_hS : (S : Set X) = nonvanishingLocus L s) :
    ∃ c : ∀ (W : X.Opens) (p : ℕ), CohomologyFractionPresentation L F s p W →+
      (openModuleCohomology X.toRingedSpace p (W ⊓ S)).obj F,
      (∀ (W : X.Opens) (p n : ℕ)
        (ξ : (openModuleCohomology X.toRingedSpace p W).obj (F ⊗ L.tensorPow n : X.Modules)),
        (openModuleCohomology X.toRingedSpace p (W ⊓ S)).map
            (((ρ_ F).inv ≫ F ◁ tensorPowSection (homOfGlobalSection L s) n) :
              F ⟶ (F ⊗ L.tensorPow n : X.Modules))
            (c W p (cohomologyFraction L F s p W n ξ)) =
          (openModuleCohomologyRestriction X.toRingedSpace p
            (homOfLE (inf_le_left : W ⊓ S ≤ W))).app (F ⊗ L.tensorPow n : X.Modules) ξ)
